item.title: Awaodori Chicken: Tokushima's Prized Jidori — Guide
item.description: Awaodori chicken (Awaodori-dori) is Tokushima’s celebrated brand of jidori — premium free-range chicken raised to high standards for superior flavour and texture. Named after the prefecture’s famous dance, the birds are raised with room to move and a longer growing period, giving meat that is firm, richly flavoured and less fatty than mass-produced chicken, with a satisfying bite. It is prized across a range of dishes: grilled over charcoal (yakitori and whole cuts), simmered in a rich hotpot (mizutaki or sukiyaki-style), served as tataki or even sashimi where freshness allows, and in rice dishes.
